d: Exploring the historic streets of Cusco, Peru, as an Indian traveler! In this vlog, I take you along on a memorable day where I experienced the genuine hospitality of Peruvian locals. While walking around the city, I had a lovely conversation with some local students who were very helpful and kind. It is a good feeling to see how people from different parts of the world welcome you. The locals here showed love towards Indian tourists, making my time in Cusco special. If you want to see how Peruvians interact with travelers from India, this video gives you a real look into their welcoming…
